get.description: Each `data:` frame is a ChangeEvent — an **invalidation signal, not a delta**. It says what kind of thing changed, never what it became, so clients re-read. There is no `changedSince` cursor and no tombstone. The stream opens with `retry: 3000` and sends a `: ping` comment every 25s. Note that `EventSource` cannot carry an `Authorization` header — read the body as a stream instead.
